item.title: MATCH RECAP: North Carolina FC defeats Greenville Triumph 2-1 for third consecutive victory - North Carolina FC
item.description: North Carolina FC jumps to the top of the USL League One table following a 2-1 road victory over Greenville Triumph SC. Two first half penalties, both of which eventually found their way to the back of the net, shaped the matchup between the two that saw the visitors take all three points.
